description: Change of use of part car dealership (sui generis) to rental vehicle premises comprising parking, storage and minor maintenance of rental vehicles and office (sui generis) with associated works.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Cover Letter], [Unnumbered Existing and Proposed Elevations], [Unnumbered Site Plan], [Unnumbered Location Plan], [Unnumbered Proposed Elevations], [Unnumbered Sign Specification], [Unnumbered Proposed Site Plan], Received: 12/03/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is first brought into use, the existing eastern vehicular access to London Road shall be permanently closed and the kerbs and footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development, details of secure cycle storage arrangements to accommodate a minimum of 7 cycles shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and shall consist of horizontal storage arrangement to ensure accessibility for all members of staff. The cycle parking shall conform to the West London Cycle Parking Guidance. The cycle stores shall be made available to staff upon first occupation of the hereby approved development and maintained as such thereafter without obstruction.
Condition : 5 - No vehicles delivered to the site shall be unloaded on to the public highway.
